name: Hanging Knee Raise
steps: Grip a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip and hang with your arms straight, shoulders lightly active, and legs together.
Brace your core and flex your hips to raise both bent knees up toward your chest.
At the top, curl your pelvis slightly upward to fully contract your abs.
Lower your legs slowly back to the hanging starting position without swinging.
tips: Stop any pendulum swing at the bottom before starting the next repetition.
Focus on curling your tailbone upward at the top rather than just lifting your knees with your hip flexors.
